_style: Drawn as a clean 3D game-asset concept render in a stylised anime background-art style: simple confident shapes, flat hand-painted colours with one soft shadow tone, crisp edges, no photographic noise. The WHOLE object is in frame with margin on every side, seen from a three-quarter front view slightly above eye level, centred on a plain pure white background. Soft even studio light, no cast shadow on the ground, no reflections, no people, no text, no lettering, no writing in any language, no numbers, no logos, no brand badges, no watermark.
VendingMachine: A Japanese street drinks vending machine, 1.9 metres tall and 1.1 metres wide, a plain upright box. Pale blue-white body, a large window in the upper half showing three neat rows of plain single-colour drink cans and bottles with no labels, a row of small round buttons under each row, a coin slot panel on the right, and a dark collection flap at the bottom. Every panel is blank: no brand, no price tags, no writing.
StreetLamp: A single tall city street lamp, about six metres tall. A slender tapered dark green steel column on a short ribbed cast base, with one curved arm reaching out to one side at the top and an old-fashioned lantern-shaped lamp head with warm cream glass hanging from the end of the arm. Seen directly from the side so the whole column and the arm are visible.
Planter: A pavement planter: a tapered square pale concrete tub about 1.2 metres long and 60 centimetres tall with a thick rim, filled with a dense rounded mound of small-leaved green shrub with a few clusters of small white flowers. Chunky simple leaf masses, not individual thin leaves.
PotRow: Five mismatched plant pots standing in a straight row on the ground, as outside a small Japanese shop door, the whole row about two metres long. A terracotta pot, a blue glazed pot, a white square pot, a tall grey pot and a small brown bowl, each with a different chunky plant: a round shrub, a spiky succulent, a fern, a small flowering bush with pink flowers, and a herb. Simple solid leaf masses.
Dumpster: A wheeled commercial waste bin, the big rectangular back-alley kind, 1.8 metres long and 1.1 metres tall, with a flared body, four small castor wheels, vertical stiffening ribs on the sides, and a two-part black lid that is closed. Body in worn dark teal green with a few scuffs. Blank, no stencils or stickers.
AFrameSign: A small pavement A-frame sandwich board sign about one metre tall: a folding wooden frame in warm honey-coloured wood holding a blackboard panel on each face. The blackboard is empty except for a simple white chalk drawing of a coffee cup with a curl of steam. No words at all.
GasBottles: Four tall grey propane gas cylinders standing upright side by side inside an open steel cage made of square mesh, the kind found behind a restaurant. The cage is 95 centimetres wide and 1.15 metres tall with a hinged front door. Each cylinder has a rounded top with a small valve and a red protective collar. No labels or warning stickers.
Bench: A city park bench 1.8 metres long with ornate black cast-iron end frames and armrests, and a seat and backrest made of thick warm brown wooden slats. Seen from the front three-quarter view.
CafeEspresso: A commercial two-group espresso machine for a cafe counter, 80 centimetres wide and 65 centimetres tall. Polished cream enamel body with brushed steel front, two group heads with portafilter handles in dark wood, a steam wand on each side, round pressure gauges with blank faces, a row of small white cups warming on the top tray, and a drip tray at the bottom. No brand name.
CafeRegister: A small cafe cash register for a counter top, about 35 centimetres wide and 37 centimetres tall. A compact vintage-style till in teal enamel with a slanted panel of round cream keys with blank tops, a small blank dark display on a short neck, and a closed cash drawer with a brass handle at the bottom. No numbers and no writing anywhere.
CafePastryCase: A glass pastry display case for a cafe counter, 1.2 metres wide and 75 centimetres tall, with a curved glass front, a warm wooden base and frame, and two shelves holding neat rows of croissants, strawberry cakes, round fruit tarts and muffins. The glass is clear and the pastries are simple chunky shapes. No labels or price cards.
CafePlantTall: A tall indoor potted plant for a cafe corner, about 1.4 metres tall: a fiddle-leaf fig with a slim trunk and a dozen very large, thick, glossy dark green leaves, in a round woven wicker basket pot. Big simple chunky leaves.
CafePlantSmall: A small potted succulent for a shelf, about 22 centimetres tall: a plump rosette of thick pale green leaves with pink tips in a small round white ceramic pot on a tiny saucer. Very simple and chunky.
CafeStool: A cafe bar stool 75 centimetres tall: a round padded seat in tan leather on four slim black steel legs that splay slightly outward, joined by a round steel footrest ring halfway up. Simple and sturdy, legs clearly thick.
